Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace.
The effort matches the outcome, and the athlete's performance serves the competitive standard of the sport.
Mollie O'Callaghan competed in the 200m freestyle trials, showing immense speed early on but falling short of a world record while still qualifying for the Commonwealth Games.

The Bright Side:
Her performance demonstrates the peak of human physical discipline and the pursuit of excellence.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error; the action (swimming) and the effect (qualification) are perfectly aligned.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
